name: literature_survey
description: Create a citation-traceable literature survey from the current graph or a compatible paper set.

environment.name: LLM_BASE_URL
environment.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used by the packaged SurveyAgent runtime.

environment.name: LLM_MODEL
environment.description: Provider model id used by the packaged SurveyAgent runtime.

environment.name: LLM_CONTEXT_WINDOW
environment.description: Context-window hint for survey prompt planning.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_DEFAULT_MAX_PAPERS
environment.description: Default paper budget materialized from the upstream graph or paper set.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_MAX_PAPERS_LIMIT
environment.description: Hard upper bound for --max-papers in the packaged CLI.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_DEFAULT_MIN_PAPERS
environment.description: Minimum real-paper count required for a successful survey audit.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_DEFAULT_DEPTH
environment.description: Default compatibility depth metadata: brief, standard, or deep.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
environment.description: Default language metadata recorded in survey artifacts.

environment.name: XLAB_LITERATURE_SURVEY_ENABLE_FULL_TEXT
environment.description: Opt-in switch for full-text synthesis paths when supported by the runtime.

artifacts.description: Readable Markdown literature survey with paper-id citations
Structured survey sections, claims, gaps, and references
Audit report for completeness and citation traceability

arguments.name: --topic
arguments.description: Set the survey topic explicitly; a quoted positional topic is preferred.

arguments.name: --graph
arguments.description: Override the active workspace knowledge graph with a graph handle or path.

arguments.name: --language
arguments.description: Set the language recorded for the generated survey.

arguments.name: --depth
arguments.description: Set survey depth metadata and planning detail.

arguments.name: --max-papers
arguments.description: Set the maximum number of real papers to materialize.

arguments.name: --min-papers
arguments.description: Set the minimum real-paper count required by the audit.

arguments.name: --facet
arguments.description: Add a survey facet; repeat the flag to add more facets.

arguments.name: --full-text
arguments.description: Request full-text synthesis when the runtime supports it.

arguments.name: --resume
arguments.description: Resume from compatible run-local survey state.

arguments.name: --input
arguments.description: Use a local paper manifest compatibility input instead of the active graph.

phases.label: Initialize
phases.description: Parse arguments, snapshot runtime config, and prepare run-local state.

phases.label: Ingest sources
phases.description: Load real papers from a graph or compatibility paper manifest.

phases.label: Graph context
phases.description: Extract bounded knowledge-graph context for orientation.

phases.label: Cluster
phases.description: Cluster papers and build chronology context.

phases.label: SurveyAgent
phases.description: Run the integrated Xcientist outline, draft, review, refine, and judge path.

phases.label: Audit
phases.description: Validate schemas, citations, provenance, lineage, and secret-free artifacts.
